title: v5.80.0 shipped: Interior census accuracy: decay separation + _2-suffix fresh-face fix
summary: D1 decay separation — deleted the peak self-refresh (fresh==peak) and the house-zone linear slope, adopted instant-drop; publishes peak_held/peak_age_seconds/count_as_of/peak_refresh_suppressed_count. Targets the measured 74.5% of over-count time that was a decay tail with no live camera evidence. D2 _2-suffix fresh-face fix — registry-resolves the 4 string-built Frigate face/last_camera sites (fail-closed), reviving face-based dedup that had fired 0x/7d. Tier 2-DB: 3 framing-disjoint reviews + fix-up (B-HIGH-1 map-rebuild orchestrator-drilled). Non-goals: no guest logic, no dedup repair (config not code), no exterior swap (KEEP BOTH). Empty house is the discriminating decay test.
